Method of Attack: Remote code execution via zero-day vulnerability in SolarWinds Serv-U FTP server when SSH is enabled
Execution of malicious commands and scripts for persistence and remote access
Adding global admin users to Serv-U FTP server configuration
Piping cmd.exe command outputs to internet-accessible folders to retrieve results
Attack Vector: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability in Serv-U FTP server with SSH enabled
Indicators of Compromise: Recently created .txt files under Client\Common\ folder
Serv-U DebugSocketLog.txt log file with exception 'C0000005; CSUSSHSocket::ProcessReceive'
Unrecognized global users in Serv-U configuration
Serv-U spawned processes for mshta.exe, powershell.exe, cmd.exe, and processes running from C:\Windows\temp
